verses.text: “If one ventures a word with you, will you be wearied? Yet who can keep from speaking?

verses.text: Consider now, I plead: Who, being innocent, has ever perished? Or where have the upright been destroyed?

verses.text: ‘Can a mortal be more righteous than God, or a man more pure than his Maker?
